description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with Git repositories, including cloning repositories, fetching diffs from GitHub, extracting changed files from zip archives, and validating repository info. It is part of a backend system managing repository data and updates.

methods.name: partial_clone
methods.description: Clones the diff between two commits, applying pre-MVP filtering, and saves changed files to the repository directory.

methods.name: get_diff_from_github
methods.description: Uses the GitHub API to compare commits between two SHA versions and returns the diff JSON.

methods.name: create_changed_files_dict
methods.description: Creates a dictionary of changed files filtered by '.java' extension based on GitHub diff data.

methods.name: get_latest_repo_data_from_github
methods.description: Downloads the latest repository data as a zip archive from GitHub.

methods.name: extract_files
methods.description: Extracts specified files from a zip archive into the repository directory.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a repository from a URL, purging existing directory if necessary.

methods.name: extract_and_validate_repo_info
methods.description: Extracts and validates repository information from input data, aborting if required fields are missing.
